method: Edit Mode public-API height fixtures; saved MuseumStart queued synthetic HMD/controller/keyboard states in normal Dynamic input updates through production Input Actions and XR ray selection. Late-camera fixture clones only the Play Mode palette. No manual SelectEnter, HoverEnter, TriggerProgrammatically or InputSystem.Update calls.
limitations: No real headset/controller, comfort, learning study or executable build verification. Floor/Device pose fixtures are labelled separately from main-scene synthetic input. Input injection refuses a real InputSystem XRHMD. Product scene, prefab and input assets are never saved.
